title: Bounded exact stratum base change for arbitrary condensed coefficients
statement:
Let Λ be any commutative condensed ring, with pulled-back coefficient rings on the small pro-etale sites of schemes [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. Use the exact termwise module functors and actual exchange mates [lem-sfb-condensed-stratum-base-change-calculus]. Both the open immersion and its base change are assumed quasi-compact. Let $h:T'\to T$, let $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ be open with closed complement $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$, and form their fibre products $j':U'\hookrightarrow T'$ and $i':Z'\hookrightarrow T'$, with projections $h_U:U'\to U$ and $h_Z:Z'\to Z$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion]. For every $N\in D^b(U,R_U)$ the map
$$\beta_N:j'_!h_U^*N\longrightarrow h^*j_!N$$
adjoint to $h_U^*N\cong j'^*h^*j_!N$, using the open adjunction unit and pullback composition, is an isomorphism. For every $N\in D^b(Z,R_Z)$ the map
$$\gamma_N:h^*i_*N\longrightarrow i'_*h_Z^*N$$
is an isomorphism; it is the closed adjunction unit followed by $i'^*h^*i_*N\cong h_Z^*N$. Under the canonical identifications, $j'^*\beta_N$ and $i'^*\gamma_N$ are identities, while $i'^*\beta_N$ and $j'^*\gamma_N$ are the maps between zero objects.

 Both sides are bounded, both actual open units and closed counits are invertible, and the natural isomorphisms have exactly the specified mate as their hom after whiskering by the full bounded inclusion. No constructibility or derived-completeness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Apply the exact unbounded calculus to obtain closed exactness and invertible actual open and closed mates. Restrict them by whiskering with the full bounded inclusion.

Exact-functor homology preserves both cohomological bounds. Supply the actual unit and counit transpose equations from the unbounded calculus. The mixed restrictions are zero by support vanishing and square transport; maps with zero source are uniquely zero.

theorem bounded_open_closed_base_change
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {U Z T Up Zp Tp : Scheme.{u}}
    {h : Tp ⟶ T} {j : U ⟶ T} {i : Z ⟶ T}
    {hU : Up ⟶ U} {jp : Up ⟶ Tp} {hZ : Zp ⟶ Z} {ip : Zp ⟶ Tp}
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsClosedImmersion i] [QuasiCompact j]
    [IsOpenImmersion jp] [IsClosedImmersion ip] [QuasiCompact jp]
    (hcomp : Set.range j = (Set.range i)ᶜ)
    (sqU : IsPullback hU jp j h) (sqZ : IsPullback hZ ip i h) :
    Exists fun [_hi : PreservesFiniteColimits (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ i)] ↦
    Exists fun [_hip : PreservesFiniteColimits (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ
            ip)] ↦
      (∃ beta : DerivedCategory.Bounded.ι ⋙ ((pullback Λ hU) ⋙
            (openExtension Λ jp)) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Bounded.ι ⋙ ((openExtension Λ j) ⋙
            (pullback Λ h)),
        beta.hom = Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Bounded.ι (openMate
            Λ
            sqU.toCommSq)) ∧
      (∃ gamma : DerivedCategory.Bounded.ι ⋙ ((closedDirectImage Λ
            i) ⋙
            (pullback Λ h)) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Bounded.ι ⋙ ((pullback Λ hZ) ⋙
            (closedDirectImage Λ ip)),
        gamma.hom = Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Bounded.ι (closedMate
            Λ
            sqZ.toCommSq)) ∧
      (∀ N : DerivedCategory.Bounded
          (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
            (condensedRingObj Λ U)),
        DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded
            (((pullback Λ hU) ⋙
            (openExtension Λ jp)).obj N.obj) ∧
        DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded
            (((openExtension Λ j)
            ⋙ (pullback Λ h)).obj N.obj) ∧
        IsIso ((openAdjunction Λ jp).unit.app ((pullback
            Λ hU).obj
            N.obj)) ∧
        IsIso ((openAdjunction Λ j).unit.app N.obj) ∧
        (openAdjunction Λ jp).unit.app
            ((pullback Λ hU).obj N.obj) ≫
            (pullback Λ jp).map
            ((openMate
            Λ sqU.toCommSq).app N.obj) =
          (pullback Λ hU).map
            ((openAdjunction Λ j).unit.app N.obj) ≫
            (pullbackSquare Λ sqU.toCommSq).hom.app
            ((openExtension Λ j).obj N.obj) ∧
        IsZero ((pullback Λ ip).obj
          (((pullback Λ hU) ⋙
            (openExtension Λ jp)).obj N.obj)) ∧
        IsZero ((pullback Λ ip).obj
          (((openExtension Λ j) ⋙
            (pullback Λ h)).obj N.obj)) ∧
        (pullback Λ ip).map
            ((openMate
            Λ
            sqU.toCommSq).app N.obj) = 0) ∧
      (∀ N : DerivedCategory.Bounded
          (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1})
            (condensedRingObj Λ Z)),
        DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded
            (((closedDirectImage Λ i) ⋙
            (pullback Λ h)).obj N.obj) ∧
        DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded
            (((pullback Λ hZ) ⋙
            (closedDirectImage Λ ip)).obj N.obj) ∧
        IsIso ((closedAdjunction Λ i).counit.app N.obj) ∧
        IsIso ((closedAdjunction Λ ip).counit.app ((pullback
            Λ hZ).obj N.obj)) ∧
        (pullback Λ ip).map
            ((closedMate
            Λ sqZ.toCommSq).app N.obj) ≫
            (closedAdjunction Λ ip).counit.app ((pullback
            Λ hZ).obj N.obj) =
          (pullbackSquare Λ sqZ.toCommSq).inv.app
            ((closedDirectImage Λ i).obj N.obj) ≫
            (pullback Λ hZ).map
            ((closedAdjunction Λ i).counit.app N.obj) ∧
        IsZero ((pullback Λ jp).obj
          (((closedDirectImage Λ i) ⋙
            (pullback Λ h)).obj N.obj)) ∧
        IsZero ((pullback Λ jp).obj
          (((pullback Λ hZ) ⋙
            (closedDirectImage Λ ip)).obj N.obj)) ∧
        (pullback Λ jp).map
            ((closedMate
            Λ sqZ.toCommSq).app N.obj) = 0)
